person_note: The controlling narration is third person with shifting focalization among Roger White, Charlie Croker, Martha Croker, Raymond Peepgass, Conrad Hensley, and others. Multiple Goodreads event passages independently show this external narrating position, and both the publisher’s opening and an authorized interior chapter sustain the same technique. First-person material in the quotes belongs to dialogue, attributed thought, or embedded Stoic discourse; generic you passages are not second-person narration. The only material uncertainty is the missing local boundary around q00025, but it does not outweigh the consistent book-level evidence, and no sustained alternate-person section was found.
